question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series? 

MGB, NIE, OKH, PMK, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (1), (2) and (3) are added to the position values of 1st, 2nd and 3rd letter respectively according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87ec6077df7d3c94405293597a451bc998e5b9c948ea0a39fd23b005e3c8b566.png] 

​Hence, "**QON**" is the correct answer.
